title: Rollback to a previous published version
description: From the Publish Studio history, an admin reactivates an older published version via the two-click inline confirm, and that version becomes the active one.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the username field with testadmin
Fill in the password field with TestAdmin123!
Submit the login form
Navigate to /admin/publish (the Publish Studio)
Open the 'Publicação' tab to see the version history list

If fewer than 2 versions exist in the history: make a small edit in the studio so the draft becomes dirty, click 'Publicar mudanças' at the top, then confirm with the 'Publicar vN' button in the inline strip; repeat until at least 2 versions exist
On a non-active version in the history (one without the 'ativa' badge), click the 'Voltar pra esta' button
Verify an inline confirmation strip appears asking to go back to this version (message contains 'Voltar pra esta versão?')
Click 'Confirmar' in the inline strip
Verify the chosen version now shows the 'ativa' badge
Verify exactly one version in the history shows the 'ativa' badge

title: See empty publication history state
description: An admin account that has never published sees the empty history state in the Publicação tab.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the username field with puczaras
Fill in the password field with Zup Paras
Submit the login form
Open the admin management view and create a new admin account with a unique username (e.g. emptyhist<random>) and password EmptyHist123!
Log out of the master account
Log in with the freshly created admin account
Navigate to /admin/publish and open the 'Publicação' tab
Verify the empty history state is shown with the text 'Nenhuma versão publicada ainda'
Verify no version entries and no 'ativa' badge are rendered in the history list

title: Cancel publishing from the confirmation strip
description: Opening the publish confirmation strip and canceling it closes the strip without creating a new version.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the username field with testadmin
Fill in the password field with TestAdmin123!
Submit the login form
Navigate to /admin/publish (the Publish Studio)
Open the 'Publicação' tab and note how many versions currently exist in the history and which version number is the highest
Make a small edit in the studio so the draft becomes dirty and the top button reads 'Publicar mudanças'
Click 'Publicar mudanças' to open the inline confirmation strip
Verify the inline strip is visible with a 'Publicar vN' confirm button and a 'cancelar' option
Click 'cancelar' in the inline strip
Verify the strip closes and the top button reads 'Publicar mudanças' again (draft still dirty, not published)
Verify the version history still has the same number of versions as noted before (no new version was created)
